# laravel_cloud_deployment (Resource)

Initiates a deployment on a Laravel Cloud environment.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID to deploy.

### Read-Only

- `branch_name` (String) Branch name used for the deployment.
- `build_command` (String) Build command executed during deployment.
- `commit_author` (String) Commit author.
- `commit_hash` (String) Commit hash of the deployment.
- `commit_message` (String) Commit message.
- `failure_reason` (String) Reason for failure, if any.
- `finished_at` (String) Deployment finish timestamp.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `node_version` (String) Node.js version used for the deployment.
- `php_major_version` (String) PHP version used for the deployment.
- `started_at` (String) Deployment start timestamp.
- `status` (String) Deployment status.
- `uses_octane` (Boolean) Whether the deployment uses Laravel Octane.
